notes.title: Update #3
notes.content:
[b]Update Notes[/b]
- Fixed leaderboard
- Changed textures
- Added "Practice Alone" mode
- Added option to change race length
- Improved tire wear
- Pit stops now fix car damage
- Added Pause Menu animation
- Added "Wrong Way" signs
- Added Speed Boost pads
- Improved Pause Menu
- Added gridspots to Forest tracks
- Improved grass texture
- Improved skybox
- Reduced default race time

notes.title: Update #1 + Price decrease
notes.content:
Velocity Valley's price has decreased. After careful consideration and listening to your valuable feedback, we have decided to reduce the price of our game. This allows Velocity Valley to be accessible to a broader audience. This price adjustment is expected to contribute to an even more enjoyable experience for all players. Thank you for your support for Velocity Valley. Looking forward to seeing you in-game and hearing your thoughts on this change!

UPDATE NOTES
Fixed race ending at "00:01" instead of "00:00"
Removed lap bonus
Fixed countdown sound
Removed off grass penalty
Lowered tracks to the ground
Fixed pause between intro and looping section in the music
Added tenths and hundredths to lap time
Changed scoreboard
Changed main menu background
Changed race finish background
Added bleachers to some tracks
Changed steering
Changed old tires
Changed soft, medium, and hard tire grip
Added car damage
